**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **What the document has:** SFJ's only warranty is the funding representation at § 13.5 (p0739). Its performance obligations sit in covenants — § 2.2.2 (conduct trials per Protocol/Applicable Laws) and § 3.1.5 (Commercially Reasonable Efforts to follow SFJ's own SOPs) — and § 13.6.2 disclaims all warranties "EXCEPT AS OTHERWISE SET FORTH IN THIS ARTICLE 13," where nothing addresses SFJ's performance quality.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** no express performance warranty from the performing counterparty and no warranty remedy (re-perform/repair/refund). The software-conformance and malicious-code limbs are inapplicable to this co-development structure, so those gaps were not counted.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** amended § 13.5 into (a) funding and (b) a professional-and-workmanlike warranty keyed to the Protocol, SFJ SOPs, GCP and Applicable Laws, with re-performance at SFJ's cost and not chargeable to Development Costs. The mutual trial-outcome disclaimer at § 13.6.1 was left intact since it benefits PB, and the Article 13 carve-out in § 13.6.2 preserves the new warranty without further edits.
